aboutH2: Georgia Strait Women's Clinic: Women-Only Mental Health and Addiction Treatment in Powell River, BC
intro: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a mental health and addiction treatment facility whose team has been treating addiction since 2004, specializing in services for women with mental health, addiction, and trauma issues. They believe that the way each gender deals with such issues is dramatically different and, therefore, the treatments and therapies need to be as well. Their non-12-Step, evidence-based approach is aimed at providing specialized care to women with such needs.

pillars.title: Private, Restorative Accommodations at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic
pillars.body: At Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic, women have their own apartment-style suites with a small kitchen, seating area, private bathroom, bedroom, and wireless internet. They enjoy access to the facility’s gym, yoga studio, group dining room and TV room, laundry facilities, and the quiet nature surrounding the centre. These private accommodations allow women to feel comfortable and safe during their treatment.

pillars.title: Specialized Programming for Each Woman at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic
pillars.body: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic specializes in helping women who have experienced trauma. They create an atmosphere of support and safety where women can work through past traumas and gain the tools they need to thrive. The use of cell phones and laptops allows women to stay connected with employers, employees, and family during their treatment. Their on-staff nursing and clinical detoxification ensure the safety and comfort of women at all stages of their treatment.

pillars.title: Expert and Empathetic Professionals at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic
pillars.body: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic emphasizes the importance of having a highly skilled, compassionate, and curious team of professionals to help each client, be it a woman, non-binary, or transgendered individual. Many of their staff members have walked through addiction themselves, which gives them unmatched empathy and expert clinical knowledge. They offer the privacy and attention of a smaller facility while operating as a large facility.

overviewH2: Georgia Strait Women's Clinic: Center Overview
overview: The Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is a specialized treatment facility that offers comprehensive services to women who are struggling with their mental health. Since 1991, the clinic has been providing licensed and accredited mental health programs, including 24-hour medical care, psychiatry, psychology, nutrition, and fitness support. Additionally, the clinic provides specialized bodywork and other essential services, bringing together the expertise of highly-trained, experienced professionals who are committed to high-quality care.

afterOverview: The clinic has helped numerous women overcome their mental health challenges and has treated over 4,492 patients. The senior staff and health professionals boast a collective 121 years of addiction and mental health care experience. The clinic’s focus is on high-functioning and motivated women, and it does not provide 12-step treatments for addiction. As the only women’s-only facility of its kind in Canada, Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is committed to providing specialized care to women who want to improve their mental health and well-being.

location.heading: Georgia Strait Women's Clinic in Powell River, British Columbia
location.intro: Georgia Strait Women's Clinic is on Highway 101 just south of Powell River, in the qathet region of BC's upper Sunshine Coast, and its Cliffside building looks straight out over the Georgia Strait. From Vancouver it is a 25-minute flight, or roughly 5 to 6 hours by road with the Horseshoe Bay and Earls Cove ferries, while people coming from Vancouver Island can take the 90-minute Comox ferry, which puts Courtenay about 2 hours away and Nanaimo about 3 and a half.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Georgia Strait Women's Clinic cost?
faqs.a: recovery.com lists an estimated cash rate of $34,000 to $36,000 for 30 days. The clinic does not post its fees online, so call admissions at 1.866.487.9040 for the current fee schedule and what it includes. Post-treatment coaching and alumni support are part of the cost.

Most women stay at least 30 days, counted from the day the doctor clears you to start programming after any withdrawal care. The length is flexible, and many clients stay a few extra weeks or longer when they still have something to work on. You and your funder decide how long to stay.

faqs.q: Does Georgia Strait Women's Clinic offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. The clinic runs its own Medical Program with two private withdrawal suites and nurses on site around the clock, so you do not need to be abstinent before you arrive. You see a doctor within 24 hours, and withdrawal usually takes about 1 to 5 days before you join the program. A 7-day medical withdrawal stay is also offered to women who plan to do outpatient treatment at home.

faqs.q: Who does Georgia Strait Women's Clinic cater to?
faqs.a: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic caters to women with mental health, addiction, and trauma issues.

faqs.q: Where is the clinic and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The clinic is at 8104 Highway 101, just south of Powell River on BC's upper Sunshine Coast. Powell River has daily flights from Vancouver of about 25 minutes, and BC Ferries connects it with Comox on Vancouver Island and, through Earls Cove and Horseshoe Bay, with the Lower Mainland. Admissions arranges airport and ferry pick-ups for free, and a staff companion can meet you at Vancouver airport.

You keep getting support for as long as you want it, at no extra cost. Alumni have 24-hour phone and text support, recovery coaching in over a dozen Canadian cities or by phone, weekly virtual support meetings, alumni dinners in BC and Alberta, and free refresher weekend stays. Families can keep joining the virtual family sessions after treatment too.

faqs.q: Is this a private clinic? How can I pay?
faqs.a: Yes, Georgia Strait Women's Clinic is a private, fee-based clinic licensed by Vancouver Coastal Health. It takes self-referred clients and clients funded by organizations such as Veterans Affairs Canada, the Canadian Forces, the RCMP and WorkSafe. You can split payments across cards, wire transfer or several funders, and medical financing can cover part or all of the cost.

faqs.q: What is Georgia Strait Women's Clinic's approach to treatment?
faqs.a: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic practices a non-12-Step, evidence-based approach to treatment.

faqs.q: How long has Georgia Strait Women's Clinic been operating?
faqs.a: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic is run by the team behind Sunshine Coast Health Centre, which has treated addiction since 2004. The organization has developed licensed mental health programs since 1991, and this clinic is its sixth treatment facility.

faqs.q: What kind of professionals work at Georgia Strait Women's Clinic?
faqs.a: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic employs a highly skilled, compassionate, and curious team of professionals.

faqs.q: What makes the staff at Georgia Strait Women's Clinic unique?
faqs.a: Many of the staff members at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic have walked through addiction themselves, giving them insight and empathy.

faqs.q: How does Georgia Strait Women's Clinic ensure the safety and comfort of its clients?
faqs.a: Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic has on-staff nursing and clinical detoxification to ensure the safety and comfort of its clients.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodations are available for clients at Georgia Strait Women's Clinic?
faqs.a: Clients at Georgia Strait Women’s Clinic have their own private, apartment-style suite and access to various facilities.

faqs.q: How can clients stay connected with outside during their treatment?
faqs.a: Clients can stay connected with employers, employees, and family during their treatment through the use of cell phones and laptops.
